mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 4 Series 428i engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW 4 Series 428i engine replacement typically costs £1,200-£2,200 for a used unit, £2,200-£3,800 for a reconditioned engine, and £2,800-£4,500 for a fully rebuilt N20B20A with warranty. Supply-only prices exclude fitting - budget an additional £600-£1,000 for specialist labour.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure in a BMW 4 Series 428i?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning sign is a rattling or clacking noise from the front of the engine on start-up. As the problem worsens, you may notice a rattling or slapping noise during acceleration, poor engine performance, a check engine light, or in severe cases, the engine may fail to start or suffer catastrophic damage.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 4 Series 428i?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the car's value and condition. With a typical 428i valued at £6,000-£16,000, a rebuilt engine at £2,800-£4,500 represents a significant but often justifiable investment - especially if the car is otherwise in good condition. For cars at the lower end of the value range, a timing chain repair (£1,800-£2,800) may be the more sensible option.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 4 Series 428i engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical BMW 4 Series 428i engine replacement takes 1-2 days for a specialist workshop, assuming the replacement engine is already available. The N20 is a well-understood engine with good parts availability.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW 428i and 430i engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BMW 428i uses the N20B20A 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo petrol engine producing 245hp, while the 430i (introduced in 2016) uses the newer B48B20B 2.0-litre four-cylinder engine producing 252hp. The B48 is a more modern design with improved reliability and fewer timing chain issues, but the N20 remains a capable and enjoyable engine when properly maintained.

mainEntity.name: Does a replacement BMW 4 Series 428i engine come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - every rebuilt and reconditioned BMW 4 Series 428i engine supplied through EnginesMarket comes with a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Used engines typically carry a shorter warranty (30-90 days), so always confirm the terms with your chosen supplier.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 4 Series 428i - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 4 Series 428i was introduced as the mid-range petrol variant in the 4 Series lineup, positioned above the 420i and below the 435i. Powered by BMW's turbocharged 2.0-litre four-cylinder N20 engine, the 428i delivered a compelling blend of performance and efficiency that made it a popular choice among 4 Series buyers. In 2016, the 428i nameplate was discontinued and replaced by the 430i, which featured the newer B48 engine.

milestones.description: F32/F33 428i launched with N20B20A 2.0L four-cylinder turbo petrol, 245hp
F36 Gran Coupe 428i joins the range with the same N20B20A engine
428i xDrive variant introduced, adding four-wheel drive
428i nameplate discontinued; replaced by 430i with B48B20B engine

commonProblems.h2: BMW 4 Series 428i Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 4 Series 428i is powered by the N20 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo petrol engine. While the N20 delivers strong performance and has a loyal following, it has a well-documented Achilles' heel: the timing chain system. N20 engines are known to have a problem with the timing chain and guides that were originally installed at the factory. Rebuilt N20 engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded timing chain components addressing the original failure point, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Failure - Why the BMW 4 Series 428i N20 Engine Is Notorious for Chain Issues
problems.rootCause: The factory-installed timing chain guides can become brittle and break, allowing the chain to slacken. The timing chain can develop slack that causes rapid wear on the sprockets and plastic guides. If not addressed, the chain can skip teeth or snap entirely, leading to bent valves and catastrophic engine failure. The N20 and N26 engines are notorious for failure due to weak timing chain components.

repairOptions.longevity: Recommended at 60k miles as preventative measure
Recommended if rattling is present; prevents catastrophic failure

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW 4 Series 428i (2014-2016) is currently valued at approximately £6,000-£16,000 depending on mileage, condition, and body style (Coupe vs Gran Coupe vs Convertible) `[THIRD-PARTY - Auto Trader 2025]`. With a rebuilt engine costing £2,800-£4,500 supply-only, replacement cost represents roughly 18-75% of vehicle value. For lower-value examples approaching the £6,000 mark, a timing chain repair (£1,800-£2,800) may be the more sensible option; for cars valued above £10,000, a full replacement is comfortably justified.
problems.recommendation: The N20 timing chain issue is well-understood and, crucially, preventable if caught early. If you hear a rattling noise on cold start - especially one that lasts more than a second or two - get the chain inspected immediately. A full timing chain kit replacement at a specialist is significantly cheaper than a new engine and addresses the root cause with upgraded components. If the chain has already failed and the engine is damaged, a rebuilt N20 with upgraded timing components and a 12-month warranty is the safer long-term investment.

problems.rootCause: The high-pressure fuel pump in the N20 engine can suffer from internal wear, leading to inadequate fuel pressure. This can cause long cranking times, loss of power, and in some cases, engine stalling.

problems.recommendation: HPFP failure is less catastrophic than timing chain failure but still warrants attention. If you experience long cranking times or hesitation under acceleration, have the fuel system diagnosed promptly. Replacing the HPFP at a specialist is cost-effective and resolves the issue.

finalCta.h4: Don't Let Timing Chain Failure Write Off Your BMW 4 Series 428i
finalCta.paragraph: The N20 engine in the 428i is a fantastic powertrain - responsive, efficient, and genuinely enjoyable. But its timing chain vulnerability is real, and ignoring the warning signs can be expensive. The good news is that the issue is well-understood and preventable. Catch it early with a timing chain kit replacement at a specialist.
